heritage.name: Satori
heritage.description: Your lineage carries the awakened spark of an enlightened psionic master. You gain the psionic trait and follow the Playing a Psionic Ancestry rules. Your Ancestral Reserve has a maximum capacity of 1 Psychic Energy Point to satisfy the Reserve Rule. Use the Innate Manifestation rules for psionic powers granted by your heritage or ancestry feats. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Sense Motive and to Perception checks for initiative. You can select satori feats and feats from your base ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

feats.name: Awakened Third Eye
feats.description: Your central eye pierces the veil of the material world. You gain the Aura Sight psionic talent as an innate manifestation. Your Psionic Rank equals half your character level rounded up, and the talent scales with it.

feats.name: Echoed Intent
feats.description: Trigger: A hostile creature within 30 feet targets you with an attack roll. Requirements: You can speak. You vocalize the enemy's intended action and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. This bonus increases to +2 at 5th level and +3 at 13th level.

feats.name: Satori Insight
feats.description: You become trained in Occultism and Meditation. If your background or class would automatically train you in either skill, become trained in a skill of your choice instead. You also gain the Oddity Identification skill feat.

feats.name: Telepathic Communion
feats.description: You gain the Mindmeld psionic talent as an innate manifestation. Your Psionic Rank equals half your character level rounded up, and the talent scales with it.

feats.name: Uncanny Foreknowledge
feats.description: You gain the Defensive Precognition psionic talent as an innate manifestation. Your Psionic Rank equals half your character level rounded up, and the talent scales with it.

feats.name: Projected Empathy
feats.description: Frequency: once per day. You manifest the Telempathic Pulse psionic talent as an innate manifestation without spending Psychic Energy Points and automatically apply its Emotional Wave augmentation. The daily frequency pays the PEP cost.

feats.name: Third Eye Blinder
feats.description: Trigger: A hostile creature targets you with a mental effect. The triggering creature takes 2d6 mental damage with a basic Will save against your Psionic DC. The damage increases to 3d6 at 9th level, 4d6 at 13th level, and 5d6 at 17th level.

feats.name: Foresight Step
feats.description: Trigger: A hostile creature ends its movement adjacent to you. You Step. If this moves you out of the triggering creature's reach, it is off-guard to your next attack roll before the end of your next turn.

feats.name: Telepathic Backlash
feats.description: Trigger: You take damage from a hostile creature's melee Strike. The triggering creature takes mental damage equal to your character level and attempts a Will save against your Psionic DC or class DC, whichever is higher. Success: unaffected. Failure: stupefied 1 until the end of its next turn. Critical failure: stupefied 2 until the end of its next turn.

feats.name: Fractured Psyche
feats.description: Frequency: once per day. You can manifest the Scission advanced power as an innate manifestation. The daily frequency pays the PEP cost, but you must still possess at least 1 PEP to satisfy the Reserve Rule.

feats.name: Precognitive Evasion
feats.description: Frequency: once per day. Trigger: You would take damage from a hostile creature or hazard. Requirements: You can perceive the source. You gain resistance to all damage from the triggering effect equal to your character level.

feats.name: Aura of the Mountain Sage
feats.description: Frequency: once per day. You create a 30-foot aura for 1 minute. Enemies in the aura cannot benefit from the concealed or hidden conditions against you. You and allies in the aura gain a +2 status bonus to all saving throws.
